title: v1.0.0-beta.164
description: The derived-communities break (ADR-099): the LPA hierarchy and its edge synthesis are replaced by a prefix partition derived from the six-part entity ID (ADR-102 order — L0 org.platform.system.domain, L1 org.platform.system served, L2 org.platform); the four graph.clustering.query.* subjects and the removed config keys go with it, and the community-readiness class that #609/#618 were placed for dissolves. Tags immediately after beta.163 so sisters re-slot once against both breaks. Membership: #606 (epic) + the residual scope of #609 and #618. Gates: inventory pass + design review against the 2026-08-27 re-cut before /opsx:new; e2e:statistical AND e2e:semantic green before the breaking commit lands. Candidate selection per openspec/specs/release-candidate-proof/spec.md.
